links.outcome: Readability of ChatGPT patient-oriented answers (Flesch Reading Ease, Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level)
links.effect: Readability differed significantly across thematic categories (p < 0.01) and was described as a limitation; readability indices were not significantly correlated with accuracy or quality. No reading-level values are given in the abstract.
links.quote: ChatGPT provided patient-oriented information on gingival recession with variable performance across thematic domains; however, readability remained a limitation.

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates the quality, accuracy, and readability of ChatGPT (v3.5) responses to patient-oriented questions on gingival recession using expert raters, without testing a specific organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
